Frontend Engineer (Senior)

Engineering
Boston, MA / Remote (US)
Full-time

Halcyon Health is reimagining patient-clinician communication. Our platform is used by over 4,000 clinics nationwide and we secured $54M in Series-B funding last quarter.

We're hiring a Senior Frontend Engineer to lead the rebuild of our patient-facing portal. You'll work closely with our Head of Design and own the technical direction of a 4-engineer frontend team.

What you'll do

  • Lead the architectural rebuild of the patient portal in React 19 + TypeScript
  • Drive the design-system implementation, partnering with the Design team
  • Own performance, accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA), and frontend observability
  • Mentor 3 mid-level engineers on the team
  • Participate in our quarterly engineering planning

What we're looking for

  • 6+ years of professional frontend engineering experience
  • Deep expertise with React, TypeScript, and modern build tooling
  • Experience leading frontend architecture decisions at scale
  • Strong design sense and willingness to collaborate closely with designers
  • Track record of mentoring engineers and raising team standards
  • Familiarity with accessibility (WCAG, ARIA) and performance optimization
  • Experience with HIPAA-compliant systems is a plus

Bonus

  • Experience with Next.js, Remix, or modern SSR frameworks
  • GraphQL with Apollo Client or Relay
  • Web Components / Shadow DOM expertise
  • Healthcare or regulated-industry background

Compensation

$170,000 - $215,000 base salary based on location and experience. Equity, full medical/dental/vision, and a $2,500 home-office stipend.

Halcyon Health is an equal-opportunity employer. We sponsor visas for exceptional candidates.
